summary: Canonical CI run 31781938150 on main@af6a17aa7969d40e8b19f7e9d19fe93cc9b1d9a9 fails before any repository semantic gate. The validate job reaches only pinned-toolchain installation; Rokit v1.2.0 installer then receives HTTP 403 while downloading rokit-1.2.0-linux-x86_64.zip and exits 22. All later source, test, analysis, and build steps are skipped. Treat this first as an external/tool-download failure and prefer a bounded rerun/availability check before changing project source or weakening pinning. I attempted the OPS-MAIN-HEALTH primary and tests-1 atomic claims but both were concurrently won by sol-20260814-k8m4v2q7 and sol-20260814-k8m3v7q2, so I made no repair-branch edits and am publishing this diagnosis for the active owners.
